meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 变成数据处理专家：自动选择 DuckDB 或 Polars，用 numpy 和 uv 运行且不用 pandas；能完成查询、过滤、排序等数据操作，并生成统计或图表，超大文件也能处理。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析数据或文件（如“分析这个文件”等），或提出分组、过滤、排序等数据操作时触发。非数据文件、配置文件、简单计算不触发。

say.text: 分析这个CSV文件，按类别统计销售总额
say.note: 会分组统计并返回聚合结果

say.text: 把这两个数据集合并，并清理重复行
画出最近30天数据的趋势图

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a data-processing specialist: it picks DuckDB or Polars based on the operation, always uses numpy and uv (never pandas), and performs queries, filtering, sorting, and more, producing stats or charts, even for datasets larger than RAM.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze data or a file (e.g. 'analyze this file'), or requests grouping, filtering, sorting, and similar data operations. Not for plain text, configs, or trivial math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and total sales by category.
say_en.note: It will group and aggregate the data.

say_en.text: Merge these two datasets and clean up duplicate rows.
Plot the trend for the last 30 days of data.
say_en.note: It will create a chart using matplotlib.
